articles.title: China signals new target for 2027 asteroid deflection test
articles.summary:
China has identified a new target near-Earth asteroid for its first planetary defense kinetic test mission, which is scheduled to launch in December 2027. 
The post China signals new target for 2027 asteroid deflection test appeared first on SpaceNews.

articles.title: NASA grappling with planetary science funding shortfall
articles.summary:
NASA’s planetary science program, while spared steep cuts proposed last year, is still facing a funding shortfall that requires “strategic choices” about which missions to continue.
The post NASA grappling with planetary science funding shortfall appeared first on SpaceNews.

articles.title: OHB Sweden to build Sterna weather constellation
articles.summary: Thanks to the success of the Arctic Weather Satellite prototype and Eumetsat’s recent greenlight to develop a full constellation of similar satellites called Sterna, the European Space Agency has awarded OHB Sweden with the contract to build 20 satellites.

articles.title: Wave of Dust Rolls Through Texas
articles.summary: An advancing cold front kicked up a sharp line of sand and other small particles that swept over the high plains.
